ana: quick repro for a bundler/edge issue with our JS SDK. Works in Node, breaks when bundled for edge (vite/rollup).

ana: steps:
1) npx create-vite repro --template vanilla-ts
2) yarn add @redwood-inference/sdk
3) src/main.ts: `import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'`
4) yarn build -> deploy to edge emulator

ana: runtime error: `TypeError: require is not defined` (stack points to dist/index.cjs.js). In browser devtools sometimes `Failed to resolve module specifier "@redwood-inference/sdk"`.

david: likely cause: package `exports` forces CJS or missing ESM conditional, so bundler falls back to CJS entry. Edge runtimes are ESM-only.

mei: also seen in TS projects: our .d.ts uses `export =` which produces interop patterns that confuse ESM consumers.

sam: reproduced with Vite 5 + plugin-commonjs. Workaround: Vite alias to ESM build `resolve.alias: { '@redwood-inference/sdk': '/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js' }` or set `build.commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules: true`. Ugly but works.

ci-bot: CI repro run failed, log: `Error: TypeError: require is not defined at /node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.cjs.js:1:1`.

david: action items:
- i will inspect publish script and `exports` map (ETA today)
- sam: convert types to ESM-friendly `export default` + named exports (ETA 1 day)
- ana: add minimal repro and README steps to internal repo (ETA today)

mei: long-term: publish explicit conditional exports for import/require, audit transitive CJS deps, and add bundler integration tests (vite/rollup/webpack) to catch regressions.

ana: thanks — will add note to SDK readme about bundler pitfalls and the temp alias workaround. Reopen if patch doesn't resolve.
